description: Defines inline functions to build various error indication messages for the ocudu::fapi namespace, related to error handling in the system.

methods.name: build_error_indication
methods.description: Builds a generic error indication message with specified slot, message ID, and error ID.

methods.name: build_out_of_sync_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an out-of-sync error indication message with specified slot, message ID, and expected slot.

methods.name: build_invalid_sfn_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an invalid SFN error indication message with specified slot, message ID, and expected slot.

methods.name: build_msg_error_indication
methods.description: Builds a message slot error indication message with specified slot and message ID.

methods.name: build_msg_tx_error_indication
methods.description: Builds a message transmission error indication with specified slot.

methods.name: build_msg_ul_dci_error_indication
methods.description: Builds an UL DCI request error indication with specified slot.
